name: Tenant isolation
rule: No business data access without resolved tenant scope unless explicitly platform-admin scoped.

name: Default deny
rule: Authorization denies when no explicit policy permits action.

name: White label separation
rule: Brand configuration cannot alter protected core business rules.

name: Idempotent writes
rule: Retry-sensitive create/execute endpoints support idempotency keys.

name: Workflow transitions
rule: State transitions must be valid for definition/version and actor policy.

name: Approval evidence
rule: Approval records retain actor, time, decision, source version and evidence.

name: Config versioning
rule: Governed configuration changes retain version/history and actor.

name: Feature evaluation
rule: Feature flags resolve by environment and tenant with safe defaults.

name: Event provenance
rule: Domain events include tenant, correlation, version and source record metadata.

name: Traceability
rule: Accepted changes reference GES requirement and test IDs.

name: Health semantics
rule: Readiness fails when critical dependencies required for safe traffic are unavailable.
